wire.settings.build_cache.age_hours.help: Leaves a directory alone while its newest file is younger than this. The live-build check is what protects a running compile; this is the slower second guard against a directory touched between builds.
wire.settings.build_cache.description: Prunes regenerable build output (Rust target/, Next.js .next/) when nothing is using it, and logs every removal. Run on demand with lop build-cache reap; a dry run reports what it would remove.
wire.settings.build_cache.dry_run.help: On reports the same candidates and bytes without removing anything. lop build-cache reap --dry-run forces this for one run without changing the setting.
wire.settings.build_cache.dry_run.label: Report only (dry run)
wire.settings.build_cache.enabled.help: Master switch. Off means nothing is ever removed; the command still reports what a dry run would have done.
wire.settings.build_cache.enabled.label: Reap build caches
wire.settings.build_cache.include_extra_: Off by default because their meaning varies: build/ is CMake or Gradle output in most repositories but a hand-named source directory in others, and dist/ is packaging output that some repositories commit. Turn on only if this machine's checkouts use them as output.
wire.settings.build_cache.title: Build-cache reaper
